title: JSSC Para Teacher JTAACCE Online form 2026 (7299 Posts)
postName: Assistant Acharya / Para Teacher – JTAACCE 2026 (Advt 04/2026 & backlog)
vacancyDetails: 7299 posts – about 6101 regular + 1198 backlog for Classes 1–5 and 6–8 Para Teachers
qualification: 10+2 or Graduation with D.El.Ed / B.Ed / equivalent teacher training and JTET/CTET as applicable
selectionProcess: Written Examination / as per JSSC scheme → Document Verification
documentsRequired: Educational certificates, photo ID, passport photos, signature, category certificate if applicable
howToApply:
1. Visit https://jssc.jharkhand.gov.in
2. Open JTAACCE-2026 Para Teacher apply link
3. Register and fill form for preferred posts
4. Upload documents and pay fee
5. Apply between 31 July and 30 August 2026 (as notified)
shortDescription: JSSC JTAACCE Para Teacher Online Form 2026 for 7299 posts. Apply 31 July – 30 August 2026 at jssc.jharkhand.gov.in.
content:
Jharkhand Staff Selection Commission (JSSC) has announced JTAACCE-2026 for 7,299 Para Teacher / Assistant Acharya posts in government schools.

Application window: about 31 July 2026 to 30 August 2026. Includes regular and backlog vacancies for primary and upper primary levels.
